name: Star Citizen: Hangar Extension
description:
Star Citizen: Hangar Extension improves the official Roberts Space Industries "My Hangar" area by adding better overview, filtering, exports, item details, and quality-of-life tools directly to the RSI website. It is designed for users with larger or more complex Hangars who want a clearer and more practical way to browse, organize, inspect, and export their Hangar data.

Everything runs locally inside the browser. The add-on operates directly within the official RSI Hangar and does not ask for, collect, or transmit login credentials. It requires no external services, no third-party accounts, and no external platforms. Hangar data remains in the browser and is not uploaded anywhere.


Key Features

• Clearer Hangar overview with improved layout, larger ship images, calmer background styling, and more consistent item presentation
• Advanced search, filters, sorting, and selection tools, with selected entries and search state preserved across page reloads
• Displays included ships and vehicles directly inside their parent Hangar entry, for example the G12 included with the 600i Explorer
• Clickable ship names within each Hangar pledge entry, linking directly to the corresponding RSI ship pages
• Local Hangar cache with incremental updates, avoiding full Hangar recaching for reliably detectable Hangar changes
• Improved Buy Back navigation with cleaner filters, keyboard navigation, and controls aligned more closely with the main Hangar
• Bulk overview for ships, CCUs, packages, store credits, selected entries, Hangar values, and value comparison totals
• Optional value comparison with current RSI prices, showing the difference in USD and percent with a visual indicator
• Optional display of Pledge IDs, base pledges, USD values, production state, and additional ship details
• Improved handling of ship upgrades, modules, coupons, insurance entries, and RSI Hangar edge cases
• Keyboard and quick navigation for My Hangar and Buy Back, including arrow-key page switching and double-click scroll-to-top
• Hangar CSV export that captures the full contents of each pledge, not just ships
• Fleet JSON export for ships and vehicles, including included ships and parent-child relationships


Compatibility Note

Please use only one Star Citizen hangar extension at a time. Running this add-on together with other hangar-related tools may cause unexpected behavior, since multiple tools can modify or read the same Hangar pages.

Issues caused by using multiple hangar tools at the same time cannot be reliably supported.
